Dated this the 19th day of December, 2025 The petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.378/2024 of Ernakulam North Police Station.

The offences alleged against him are under Sections 376,
376(2)(n), 406, 420 of Indian Penal Code.

2. The prosecution case is that, the accused after promising to marry the defacto complainant sexually abused her during the period from 10.11.2022 to October 2023, appropriated a sum of Rs.7,50,000/- from her and thereafter he refused to marry her and thereby he is alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, now the entire dispute between the petitioner and the defacto complainant were settled and therefore, he prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
4. The petition was opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.
5. On a perusal of the FI Statement, it is revealed that the defacto complainant was already married to another person and the said marriage was not dissolved.
It was during the said period she maintained relationship with the petitioner and stayed along with him at different places like husband and 2025:KER:98335 CRL.M.C.NO.8595 OF 2025 wife.
Subsequently, she came to know that the petitioner was also married to another lady and thereafter the relationship got strained.
Therefore, it can be seen that the relationship between them was a consensual one.
The affidavit filed by the defacto complainant also states that the matter has been settled and also that further proceedings against the petitioner can be quashed.
6. In the above circumstances, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioner further as it will only be an abuse of the process of the court.
Therefore, this Crl.M.C. is allowed.
All further proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.378/2024 of Ernakulam North Police Station, stands quashed.

Sd/-
 C. PRATHEEP KUMAR,
